cards.name: Marsh Casualties
cards.oracle_text:
Kicker {3} (You may pay an additional {3} as you cast this spell.)
Creatures target player controls get -1/-1 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, those creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn instead.

cards.name: Boggart Mischief
cards.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, you may blight 1. If you do, create two 1/1 black and red Goblin creature tokens. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Whenever a Goblin creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Deathmark
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target green or white creature.

cards.name: Footbottom Feast
cards.oracle_text:

cards.name: Mordor Trebuchet
cards.oracle_text:
Defender
Whenever you attack with one or more Goblins and/or Orcs, create a 2/1 colorless Construct artifact creature token with flying named Ballistic Boulder that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice that token at end of combat.

cards.name: Atrocious Experiment
cards.oracle_text: Target player mills two cards, draws two cards, and loses 2 life. (To mill a card, a player puts the top card of their library into their graveyard.)
